mechanism: Nifedipine (vasodilator) and captopril (ACE inhibitor) both lower blood pressure through different mechanisms, resulting in additive hypotensive effects and increased risk of syncope, dizziness, or renal hypoperfusion.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely when combining these agents; dose adjustment may be necessary, and patients should be counseled on orthostatic hypotension symptoms; renal function should be assessed periodically.
